correctness.rationale: On every Euclidean frame, if w has a successor then all its successors see one identical reflexive complete S5 cluster C. The identity R(z)=C for z in C follows by two Euclidean applications; no transitivity/seriality assumption enters. BKS 2025 Theorem 4.4 and Lemma 4.7 (verified directly in full primary PDF) supply polynomial tree-size Boolean-basis conversion on S5. Replace maximal outer modal subformulas by their S5-compiled scopes (valid at every immediate successor), and compile the purely propositional outer skeleton by standard fixed-basis balancing. The total size is bounded by the product of two fixed polynomials, uses only original variables, and preserves truth at every root including dead ends.
